The structure of Mg3Ti2Mo2O12 crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 36 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg, Mo, and Ti centers each coordinated octahedrally by six O neighbors, while O centers adopt a square-pyramidal environment with five geometric neighbors. The polyhedra connect through corner-sharing between MgO6 and MoO6 octahedra, and edge-sharing between MgO6 and TiO6 octahedra; the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites.
